source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: While declaring battle formations before the battle, you may put any number of friendly units, other than FORTIFICATIONS, into strategic reserves. Rather than being deployed, they are set aside as strategic reserves units and come onto the battlefield at a later point. Unless a rule says otherwise, your strategic reserves units together may be worth no more than half (50%) of your battle size’s points limit, counting units embarked in TRANSPORTS that are themselves in strategic reserves. “Reserves” is another name for strategic reserves. Units still in strategic reserves when the final turn ends are destroyed, but their destruction sets off no on-destruction rules.
